title: Morni Hills - The Hidden Hill Station of Haryana
content:
Morni Hills, Haryana

Morni Hills is a peaceful and scenic hill destination located in the Panchkula district of Haryana. Known as the only hill station in Haryana, Morni Hills is a perfect getaway for nature lovers, adventure seekers, and travelers who want a calm break from busy city life.

Surrounded by lush greenery, winding roads, fresh mountain air, and beautiful lakes, Morni Hills offers a refreshing experience. Unlike crowded hill stations, it remains quiet, clean, and less explored, making it a hidden gem of North India.

Why Morni Hills is Famous

Morni Hills is famous for its natural beauty, calm environment, and stunning views of the Shivalik ranges. The hills are named after a queen called Morni, and local legends are connected with the region.

This destination is ideal for:

  • Weekend trips from Chandigarh and Delhi
  • Nature walks and trekking
  • Picnic spots with family and friends
  • Peaceful mountain stay experiences

Natural Beauty and Landscape

Morni Hills is located at an altitude of around 1,200 meters above sea level. The area is covered with forests of pine and other Himalayan trees. The scenic roads, misty mornings, and chirping birds create a soothing atmosphere.

During monsoon and winter seasons, the hills look even more beautiful with clouds floating over the valleys.

Major Attractions in Morni Hills

1.  Tikkar Taal Lake

One of the most popular attractions in Morni Hills is Tikkar Taal, a beautiful lake surrounded by hills and greenery.

There are actually two lakes:

  • Bada Tikkar Taal (Big Lake)
  • Chhota Tikkar Taal (Small Lake)
  • Visitors can enjoy:
  • Boating
  • Picnics
  • Photography
  • Relaxing near the calm waters

2. Morni Fort

Morni Fort is a historic structure located on a hilltop. Though small, it offers panoramic views of the surrounding landscape. The fort reflects the heritage of the region and is a peaceful place to explore.

3. Adventure Activities

Morni Hills is also known for light adventure tourism. Activities include:

  • Trekking through forest trails
  • Cycling on hilly roads
  • Nature camping
  • Rock climbing (in certain areas)

The Haryana Tourism Department also promotes adventure camps here.

4. Nature Walks and Bird Watching

Morni Hills is a paradise for people who love silence and nature. The forests are home to many bird species, making it a great spot for bird watchers and photographers.

Early mornings are perfect for long walks with cool breezes and stunning views.

Best Time to Visit Morni Hills

  • Summer (March to June): The weather remains pleasant, making it a good escape from heat in nearby cities.
  • Monsoon (July to September): The hills become lush green and extremely scenic, but roads can be slippery.
  • Winter (October to February): Winters are cool and peaceful. Perfect for travelers who enjoy cold weather and misty landscapes.

How to Reach Morni Hills

By Road: Morni Hills is well connected by road and is around:

  • 45 km from Chandigarh
  • 35 km from Panchkula
  • 270 km from Delhi

It is an ideal weekend road trip destination.

By Train: Nearest railway station: Chandigarh Railway Station

By Air: Nearest airport: Chandigarh International Airport

Accommodation in Morni Hills

Morni Hills offers simple and comfortable stay options such as:

  • Haryana Tourism Resorts
  • Budget guesthouses
  • Small hotels near Tikkar Taal

Luxury options are limited, so advance booking is recommended during weekends.

Local Food and Culture

Food options in Morni Hills are mostly simple North Indian meals. Small roadside dhabas serve:

  • Parathas
  • Tea and snacks
  • Basic vegetarian thalis

The local culture is peaceful, rural, and closely connected with nature.

Travel Tips for Visitors

  • Carry light woolens, especially in winter
  • Wear comfortable shoes for walking and trekking
  • Avoid plastic and keep the hills clean
  • Visit early in the day for best views
  • Drive carefully on hilly roads during monsoon

Why You Should Visit Morni Hills

Morni Hills is a perfect destination for travelers who want a peaceful escape without going too far into the Himalayas. Its calm lakes, green forests, fresh air, and quiet surroundings make it ideal for relaxation and short adventure trips.

Whether you are traveling solo, with friends, or with family, Morni Hills offers a refreshing and memorable experience.
excerpt: Morni Hills is the only hill station in Haryana, offering peaceful nature and stunning views of the Shivalik ranges. Famous for Tikkar Taal Lake, it is a perfect weekend getaway near Chandigarh and Panchkula. With greenery, adventure activities, and calm surroundings, Morni Hills is an ideal escape from city life.
